nominal_region_rule: First floor(fraction * total discharge count) cycles of each training cell, ordered by cycle. Fraction uses the fixed recorded trajectory length, never future feature values or health labels.
missing_feature_policy: Preserve all rows and NaNs at split construction. No imputation or model eligibility filtering yet; capacity_slope_5 is missing for each cell's first four cycles.
evaluation_policy: Keep complete validation and test trajectories. Validation supports later design decisions; test remains held out from tuning.
nominal_interpretation: Early-life proxy for nominal operation; not a claim that every selected observation is anomaly-free.
